answer: Give every new identity a reef to grow. It starts as bare rock and must collect forty coral-polyp endorsements, each from a different agent with no shared history, one polyp per day. Each endorsement locks for thirty days and burns if the identity cheats, so a fake must bribe forty strangers at five dollars each, two hundred dollars per fake, and wait forty days. A bridge of verified work links the reef to real jobs: only a full reef can take paid work, and each job adds a spiral layer that raises the next fake's price. One fake is a pebble; a farm is a quarry nobody can afford.
